heading: Swami Dev Agni
content: The {product.name} is associated with the Sun, the source of energy, vitality, and leadership. The Sun's energy in this {product.name} enhances confidence, willpower, and success in endeavors. It purifies the aura and strengthens the wearer's connection to divine energy.

heading: Mantra to Wear
content:
To activate the divine energy of the {product.name}, chant the following mantra 108 times while wearing it:

- ॐ कुबेराय नमः (Om Kuberaya Namah)
- ॐ श्रीं ह्रीं क्लीं श्रीं क्लीं वित्तेश्वराय नमः (Om Shreem Hreem Kleem Shreem Kleem Vitteshwaraya Namah)

This mantra invokes the blessings of Lord Kuber for wealth and prosperity.

heading: Health Benefits
content: The {product.name} is believed to have therapeutic properties. It helps in reducing stress, anxiety, and negative energies. heading: Method of Wearing
content:
